title: mail crate: missing derives on Flags, TokenInfo
description:
Why this issue exists: Flags (crates/mail/src/state/flags.rs) is missing #[derive(Debug, Clone)] and TokenInfo (crates/mail/src/token_store.rs) is missing #[derive(Debug)]. These are standard derives expected on any non-trivial data structure in idiomatic Rust; their absence prevents use in debug assertions, logging, and generic contexts.

What needs to be done: Add #[derive(Debug, Clone)] to Flags and #[derive(Debug)] to TokenInfo.
